parsed.english: For every viscosity nu > 0 there are smooth, 1-periodic, divergence-free initial data u₀ and a smooth 1-periodic force f (decaying in time) such that no pair (v, p) is a smooth periodic solution of the Navier–Stokes equations on ℝ³/ℤ³ with that data. Equivalently, every candidate pair (v, p) fails to be such a solution.
parsed.why_clearer: It replaces the negated existential over (v, p) with a universal over all candidate pairs, and spells out the space as EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), so it does not depend on the local ℝ³ notation.
